# Graft

> Graft is an iPhone workout timer and log for EMOM, AMRAP, Tabata, for-time and strength workouts, with live heart rate.

## Writing workouts for Graft

- [Graft workout format (import-v1)](https://gotgraft.com/llm/import-v1.md): how to write a workout that a Graft user can paste into the app. Read it in full before writing one.
